verdict.rationale: Buzz documents named rooms or channels ('Name it, describe it'; `buzz channels create --name ... --type stream`), and threads exist: agents 'post the threads' and a benchmark task grades reply-to-thread behavior. A personalized feed may also help with catching up. However, nothing shows that every conversation is organized under a named topic or thread, or that threading is built for efficient catch-up. missing for 10: evidence of mandatory or named topic/thread organization within channels, thread-view or unread catch-up tooling for busy channels, independent or hands-on corroboration.
